messages:
riley: hey all :wave: first day! quick question — where should I post setup problems vs product questions vs casual intro? also what's the etiquette for threads vs DMs? thanks!

olivia: welcome riley! :tada: quick map: post short intros in #new-hires (name, team, timezone). For setup/access/VPN/laptop issues use #help and tag @it-ops. Product questions -> #product or the specific squad channel (eg. #eng-runtime). For infra/sysadmin stuff use #eng-infra. Threads: prefer replying in-thread for ongoing convos to keep channels clean; DM for 1:1s or sensitive stuff. If something spans teams, post once and link rather than cross-post.

sam: also — for deploys or urgent incidents ping #eng-oncall and mention @eng-oncall-bot. If you hit a CI/build failure, paste the minimal logs and steps you ran. Screenshots help.

mira: devex addendum — to manage bot noise: go to the app message and click 'Mute' or change its channel notification settings. For onboarding reminders you can DM onboarding-bot and send "start". Weekly office hours are pinned in #new-hires. We keep a lightweight channel map doc in #docs (pinned link).

riley: thanks! small follow-up — how do I opt out of noisy bots? I keep getting build notifications.

olivia: Preferences > Notifications > Manage apps lets you mute apps or set only @mentions. To leave a noisy channel: `/leave #channel-name`. If build notifications are misconfigured, mention the pipeline owner in the channel and ask them to add filters.

sam: pro tip — add your name as a keyword so you only get notified on relevant stuff. Also use the 'snooze notifications' during deep work.

mira: if you're getting DMs from onboarding-bot with checklists, you can snooze or change cadence by messaging it. For cross-team ideas that aren't tickets yet, post short notes to #ideas or #product-ideas and tag someone for follow-up.

onboarding-bot: Welcome Riley! To complete Day 0 checklist run: 
```
/complete day-0
```
Check #new-hires pinned messages for links.

riley: got it — doing the checklist now. Appreciate the quick map. one last: where do we post 'idea' brain-dumps? not ready to make a ticket.

olivia: post brain-dumps to #ideas if it's cross-team, or #product-ideas if product-specific. If you want signal, mention one or two folks and ask for a 15-min sync instead of a formal ticket.

riley: perfect, thanks everyone :raised_hands:
